name: Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026
short_description: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1km, 10km, and 5km road race held on September 5, 2026, in Kota Bharu, Kelantan, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 is a road race scheduled for September 5, 2026, in Kota Bharu, Kelantan, Malaysia. Organized by Yayasan KB Care and the Kerajaan Negeri Kelantan, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, based at Dewan Jubli Perak. Registration is currently open, with prices ranging from MYR 50 to MYR 110.

research_highlights: Course is flat and described by organizers as comfortable ('rata dan selesa'), starting and finishing at Dewan Jubli Perak on Jalan Padang Perdana, and is World Athletics certified.

Race distances are 21km Half Marathon, 10km Time Trial and 5km Fun Run, with very early starts (around 3am for the 21km category in the 2025 edition, 4am for 10km, 7:30am for 5km) likely to avoid daytime heat.
Growth trend: the inaugural 2024 edition drew over 2,000 runners (66% from outside Kelantan), rising to over 3,000 runners in 2025, making it one of the largest races on Malaysia's East Coast.
For the 2026 edition there is no race-day bib collection — runners must collect their race kit the day before (Friday, 04 September 2026).
Official cut-off times listed for 2026: 21km cut-off is 4 hours (7:00 AM), 10km cut-off is 2 hours (6:00 AM), and 5km cut-off is 1 hour (8:30 AM).
research_watchouts: One finisher's account notes the race gets tough in the back half, with energy fading noticeably after around the 16km mark.
Runners are not permitted to receive personal support from crew members along the course — water and refreshments may only be taken from official water stations.
Runners who miss checkpoint cut-off times will be pulled from the race and transported back to the finish area.
Participants must carry their IC/Passport during the race for identification if required by officials.

faqs.question: When is the Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 5, 2026. The event will be held in Kota Bharu, Kelantan, Malaysia, with Dewan Jubli Perak serving as the venue. Registration for the race is currently open for interested participants.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km option. This range allows runners of varying experience and fitness levels to select a distance that suits them.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register?
faqs.answer: Registration fees for the Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 range from MYR 50 to MYR 110, depending on the chosen distance category and possibly other factors. Registration is currently open, so interested runners can sign up for the 21.1km, 10km, or 5km race options.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Kota Bharu Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 is jointly organized by Yayasan KB Care, a foundation, and the Kerajaan Negeri Kelantan, which is the Kelantan state government. This partnership suggests a combination of community and governmental support behind the planning and execution of the event.
